caturthamapi dvārapālaṃ sādhusamāgamamupavarṇayaṃścaturṣvekaikaviṣaye
pauruṣasya puruṣārthaparyavasānaṃ darśayiṣyan vasiṣṭha uvāca - viśeṣeṇeti
taduttarakālaṃ tu jñānarūpasya sūryasya bhāsaḥ prakāśāḥ
kamalā lakṣmīstatpakṣe satā viṣṇunā samāgamaḥ sarvotkṛṣṭaṃ saundaryaṃ ca

padasya brahmātmavastunaścūḍāmaṇisthānīyasya bahūnāṃ tatprāptyai
yatamānānāṃ madhye agrāvacūlitā prathamaṃ tatprāptyā śirobhūṣaṇīkaraṇam
yaiḥ santo helayāpi na dṛṣṭāste narakāgnīnāmindhanāni poṣakā bhavanti

asadātmakaṃ sat jagacchabdasya gacchati vicāre na tiṣṭhatīti jagadityanurūpārthaṃ
dhatte saṃpādayati

yathā
uttānaśāyinaḥ puruṣasya kavervā cakravākacītkāreṇa pūrṇasya nabhaso darśane
udyataṃ utprekṣitaṃ jalarāśiṃ sara iva
maraṇe vyagrāṇāṃ cittaṃ bhrāntimūrcchonmukhamasthiraṃ ca prasiddham

brahmaiva
draṣṭṭadṛśyakramaṃ prakarṣeṇa rūḍhaṃ svīkurvatsat itthaṃ
varṇyamānaprakāreṇa jagadbhāvarūpeṇāhaṃbhāvarūpeṇa ca
bhoktṛbhogyalakṣaṇena kartṛtvasaṃtānitena sthitimupāgatamiti atra
sthitiprakaraṇe kīrtitamityuttareṇānvayaḥ

na labhyaṃ vastu dhanādi yābhyāṃ
tathāvidhau saṃkalpayitṛpuruṣapārśvasthapuruṣāntarasya svapnayuddhacirāravau
yasyāṃ tathāvidhā nagaraśrīriva

sā yathā svapnadraṣṭṭadṛśā
kiṃcitsphuṭalakṣyā saṃkalpayiturdṛśā tu īṣallakṣyāpyasatī svata eva śāmyati
tadvadityarthaḥ

tato'pyupaśāntiprakaraṇe alakṣyāvasthayā pariśeṣe śāntetyādi nava
dṛṣṭāntāḥ

śānta uparato yah saṃkalpastena kalpitasya
mattagajavanniraṅkuśasyābhrasya bhīṣaṇaḥ aśaniśabdaḥ sphūrjathustadvat
vismṛtaṃ svapnena saṃkalpena vā nirmāṇaṃ yasya nagarasya tadupamā

bhaviṣyato nagarasyodyāne prasūyate yā vandhyā tadvadamalaṃ nirmalaṃ
śūnyamevāṅgaṃ svarūpaṃ yasyāstasyā vandhyāyā jihvayā ucyamānā ye ugrā
vīrarasādyupetāḥ svaputrayuddhādikathārthāḥ

yathā vajramaṇistambhaḥ svapratibimbitasamastajanatāmavikṛta evārabhate
janatātatsamārambhāṇāṃ cādhārastadvat

cidādityaḥ svājñānaparikalpitān lokān svākāravṛttīddhena svālokena tapan
paraprakāśarūpo'pi dṛśyābhāvādeva tatprathāviṣaye andhakāroparopamaṃ
ralayorabhedāddhanībhūtāndhakāropalasadṛśaṃ paramāndhyamivāgata iti
pareṇānvayaḥ
mahāntaṃ vibhumātmānaṃ matvā dhīro na śocati iti

tathāca
śrutiḥ pādo'sya sarvā bhūtāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi iti
cidākāśasya iti pāṭhe arthāccidākāśa eva dhatte paśyati ca

mahāmaterjīvanmuktasya hṛdayaṃ paramātmaiva tasya vitatatā vistīrṇatā
hariharādīnāṃ lakṣaśatairapi tulanamiyattāparicchedaṃ

yato yasmāddhetorna vidyate
uttamamutkṛṣṭatamaṃ sattayā ānantyenānandasvābhāvyena ca
yasmāttathāvidhasyātmavastunaḥ sā pravitatā aparicchinnatā paramārthata evāsti
na tvākāśādīnāmiva draṣṭṭapuruṣāśaktikalpitetyarthaḥ
